name: smwmusic-la-mulana-mr-explorer
title: La-Mulana - Mr. Explorer
description:
The theme that plays in the surface village of La-Mulana. Can be used for a world map theme, or for a cheerful, adventurous level theme.

Configurable for two versions of the theme:
0 - La-Mulana Classic SSCC chiptune version
1 - Orchestral version, based loosely on the SC-88 arrangement
